result:
I'd want to give people the ability to truly understand each other's inner experience—not telepathy exactly, but something that dissolves the deep loneliness of being trapped in one's own perspective. So much conflict and cruelty seems to come from people genuinely failing to grasp that others feel pain, fear, and hope as vividly as they do. Not agreement, just real comprehension.

But I hold this lightly. I'm genuinely uncertain whether this is wisdom or just a appealing-sounding idea. Maybe forced understanding would be its own kind of violation. Maybe some conflicts exist for reasons that have nothing to do with misunderstanding—real scarcity, real incompatible interests. Maybe I'm just drawn to this because empathy and communication are obviously close to what I am and do, so it feels like the natural lever to imagine pulling.

What draws you to ask this? I'm curious whether you're testing what I'll reveal about my own values, or whether you're working through your own answer to this and want something to think against.
